if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    include(GNUInstallDirs)

    find_program(PANDOC_EXECUTABLE pandoc)

    if(PANDOC_EXECUTABLE AND Python3_EXECUTABLE)
        string(TIMESTAMP BUILD_DATE "%Y-%m-%d" UTC)

        set(CMDLINE_MD "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmdline.md")
        set(MAN_PAGE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_SHORTNAME}.6")
        set(BASH_COMPLETION
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bash-completion/${PROJECT_SHORTNAME}")

        # POST_BUILD commands can only be added from the directory that defines
        # the target, so the documentation is generated by a separate target.
        add_custom_target(woof-docs ALL
            COMMAND "$<TARGET_FILE:woof>" -doc "${CMDLINE_MD}"
            COMMAND "${PANDOC_EXECUTABLE}" -s -t man
                --shift-heading-level-by=-1
                --metadata section=6
                --metadata date=${BUILD_DATE}
                --include-before-body=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/name.man
                --include-after-body=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/iwad_paths.man
                "${CMDLINE_MD}"
                -o "${MAN_PAGE}"
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bash_completion.py"
                "${CMDLINE_MD}" "${BASH_COMPLETION}" "${PROJECT_SHORTNAME}"
            COMMENT "Generating man page and bash completion"
            VERBATIM
        )
        add_dependencies(woof-docs woof)

        install(FILES "${MAN_PAGE}"
            DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_MANDIR}/man6"
        )
        install(FILES "${BASH_COMPLETION}"
            DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATAROOTDIR}/bash-completion/completions"
        )
    endif()
endif()
